Vendelux | AI-Native Event Marketing Platform

# The Future of In-Person Marketing Starts Here

Vendelux turns in-person events into a predictable, pipeline-generating engine - before you even step on the show floor.

Request a Demo

Deployed across global enterprises

Event Industry Truth

## You spend six figures on events. Your team flies across the country. Sales says they’ll “try to book some meetings.” And somehow the ROI slides still feel like guesswork.

##### That Era is Over

Vendelux shows you exactly where your ICP will be, books the right meetings automatically, and ties every interaction back to revenue.

###### No gut instinct

Make decisions based on real data and insights, not guesswork.

###### No scrambling

Stay organized with streamlined workflows and clear processes.

###### No wasted budget

Optimize spending with efficient resource allocation and planning.

How It Works

# The Event Engine

01

##### Map Your ICP

Upload a list, connect your CRM, or build it from scratch. Instantly see customers, prospects, competitors, and partners - all in one place.

02

##### Match to High-ROI Events

Identify the events where your ICP is actually attending, speaking, or sponsoring - across our proprietary database of more than 250,000+ B2B events worldwide.

03

##### Book Meetings Before Day 1

AI-powered outreach engages prospects at the perfect moment. Your reps land at the event with a full calendar - and attributable ROI.

Features

# Choose Your Path

Whether you’re planning smarter, booking meetings earlier, or proving ROI down to the dollar, Vendelux gives you the tools to make every event perform. Explore the platform components that power your entire in-person strategy.

Product Overview

Meetings Event Discovery List Builder CRM Integration

Meetings

##### Fill your team’s calendars before the event even begins.

Vendelux combines verified attendee data with human-led outreach to pre-book conversations with your highest-value prospects. No scrambling. No guesswork. Just confirmed meetings that generate pipeline you can track in Salesforce or Hubspot.

Learn More

Event Discovery

##### Find the events that actually drive revenue.

Search 250,000+ B2B events and instantly pinpoint the shows where your ICP, customers, partners, and competitors will be. Make every decision backed by attendee intelligence - not anecdotal notes or last year’s list.

Learn More

List Builder

##### See who matters - and where they’ll be next.

Create dynamic lists of prospects, customers, open deals, and competitors. Track them across events, filter by roles and titles, and identify opportunities before anyone else sees them.

Learn More

CRM Integration

##### Turn Salesforce or HubSpot into your event growth engine.

Connect your CRM to monitor who’s attending upcoming events, understand deal context, and automatically push outreach lists to Sales. Measure pipeline, attribution, and ROI without manual work.

Learn More

Why Vendelux

# Vendelux is the only platform built to ensure you drive trackable ROI from your most expensive channel - Events.

Teams don't buy another event tool. They buy predictable results. Here's what Vendelux delivers in the real world.

### 300% increase in late-stage pipeline compared to the previous year

Voltage tripled their pipeline and secured the largest deal in company history by utilizing event intelligence.

The difference: identifying high-value prospects through data-driven booking instead of relying on general attendance.

View Case Study

Real Teams. Real Results.

Vendelux Raises $50M Series B to Bring AI-led Intelligence to B2B Events - FirstMark

# Vendelux Raises $50M Series B to Bring AI-led Intelligence to B2B Events

## 07.08.2026

Partner, FirstMark

When we led Vendelux’s Series A back in 2023, our conviction was simple: in-person events remain one of the highest-ROI channels in B2B go-to-market, and in a world of increasing digital noise, they would only increase in value.

Alex and Stefan had already built something remarkable: one of the largest event intelligence data repositories in existence, with tens of millions of data points spanning the world’s B2B events.

In the time since, the team has done something even more impressive: they’ve used AI to turn that data asset into something genuinely actionable, at a scale that simply wasn’t possible before.

What used to be a large dataset to support event marketers is now an intelligence and automation layer that helps marketing and sales teams identify the right events, find the right people to meet, and book meetings automatically and at scale. That shift, from data to an AI-native decision and matching engine, is the story of the last 18 months and has profoundly moved Vendelux into a “must own” in the AI-GTM stack.

The results speak for themselves. Vendelux now tracks more than 250,000 global B2B events, and thousands of marketing professionals rely on the platform to run programs that have influenced billions of dollars in event spend.

Customers across every stage, from fast-growing AI-native companies to global enterprises, are using Vendelux to bring the same visibility, ROI accountability, and predictability to their event budgets that they’ve long demanded from every other marketing channel. That’s a hard problem to solve, and Vendelux has become the category-defining platform for it.

Today, we’re thrilled to share that Vendelux has raised a $50M Series B, led by our friends at Tribeca Venture Partners, with continued participation from FirstMark and others.

As AI reshapes so much of how companies find and engage buyers, we believe human connection, and the events where it happens, only becomes more valuable, not less.

We expect this trend to keep compounding, and we couldn’t be more proud to keep backing Alex, Stefan, and the entire Vendelux team as they build the infrastructure for the next era of B2B events.

Click here to read the full Series B announcement in Business Insider

As anyone who went to Cannes Lions last month knows, the appetite for in-person gatherings is going strong. Vendelux, a live events information platform, has raised $50 million to help marketers capitalize on that.

Tribeca Venture Partners led the company's Series B raise, with S3, Pelion Ventures, HubSpot Ventures, FirstMark, and Cervin Ventures also participating, Business Insider exclusively learned. It's raised $71 million to date, including a $14 million Series A round in 2023.

Vendelux uses AI and proprietary event data from over 250,000 events
